name: Bubble Tea in Quarantine
source:
A simple and short visual novel about tea, boba, and corona.

Go on an outing to buy some bubble tea during quarantine! And make sure not to catch covid!

[From [url=https://mysmee.itch.io/bubble-tea-in-quarantine]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部关于茶、波巴和电晕的简单而简短的视觉小说。

隔离期间去郊游买珍珠奶茶吧！并确保不要感染新冠病毒！

[来自[url=https://mysmee.itch.io/bubble-tea-in-quarantine]itch.io[/url]]
